name: Flood-Net private archive
tagline: Holds Flood-Net's historical site-inspection archive, which carries site access codes and must never be public.
about: A private repository beside Flood-Net. It keeps the historical inspection workbook and everything derived from it, because those carry site-access notes and codes meant only for the people who maintain the sites. Its own workflow runs Flood-Net's ingest tools against the archive on every push and daily. It is also where Flood-Net's weekly security review files its findings and keeps its log, so a hole is never published before it is fixed. Described here only from what Flood-Net says about it in public.

status.summary: Live: holds the archive and the security-review findings; Flood-Net's git history still holds the old archive until the owner runs the rewrite.

options.what: Clone this repository on the owner's computer, run DRY_RUN=1 bash history/rewrite-meganet-history.sh, then for real, file the GitHub Support purge from history/README.md, re-clone everywhere, and push commit-map.txt to history/ (cdomotor-g/MegaNet#239 Part 2)

Share a folder holding this repository through Remote Control (a Mac or Linux computer) and let a session run the script there while the owner approves each step; then, signed in as the owner in Chrome, fill in the GitHub Support purge from history/README.md for the owner to send
options.cons: needs Claude Code on that computer

components.name: Inspection archive
components.what: The workbook and its derived files: staging rows, mined events, station crosswalk, hand-checked sample.

components.name: Derived-artefact checks
components.what: A workflow that checks out Flood-Net's tools/ingest/ beside the archive and runs its checks, on push and daily.

components.name: Security findings and log
components.what: Where the weekly security review files security-scan issues and appends its scan log.

components.name: History rewrite
components.what: A script that rewrites Flood-Net's git history without the archive; dry-run clean, waiting on the owner.

provides.name: Inspection archive
provides.what: What Flood-Net's ingest tools read, from a clone beside Flood-Net or wherever FLOODNET_PRIVATE points.

provides.name: Security-review log and findings
provides.what: The scan log the weekly review reads to pick up where the last run stopped, and its open findings.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's ingest tools and checks, checked out beside the archive at run time.
consumes.on_change: Nothing to copy: the next run uses them. If a check fails, fix the tool in Flood-Net or the data here.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's stations.json on main, which the daily workflow re-derives the station crosswalk against.
consumes.on_change: Nothing by hand: the daily run re-derives the crosswalk; look at it if the run fails.

consumes.what: The weekly security review's brief: the security-scan label, one finding per issue, the scan-log entry format.
consumes.on_change: Keep security/scan-log.md and the security-scan issues in the shape the brief describes.
